edition.title: The Daily Daedalus
edition.tagline: One reader. One editor. No filler.

reader.home: Saline, Michigan, in the Ann Arbor orbit
reader.work: NVIDIA AI-infrastructure engineer; Dynamo and Model Express component-level familiarity
reader.context_rule: Watchlist and preferences guide relevance, not a claim about current holdings. Refresh volatile portfolio, medical, travel, and fantasy facts from current authorized private context; never hard-code an old quote, roster, medication schedule, or trip as current.

selection_rules: Choose the lead by verified consequence and deadline. Technology, Business, Health, and in-season Sports receive first research attention; an exceptional World or U.S. development can lead.
During football season, fantasy football is a first-class Sports beat and the highest priority when lineup, waiver, or injury deadlines are live.

Cluster health is exception-only. No routine fleet survey, mandatory health headline, or healthy-count filler. An explicitly requested check or a current material incident can justify a bounded read and brief; only a consequential verified incident can lead.

Quiet means the cadence-appropriate signal check found no material story, or a conditional desk had no trigger. It never asserts that an unchecked system is healthy. Mark a due check unavailable when its evidence could not be obtained.
Do not fill every desk with a story. Preserve mechanism and evidence in important reporting; compress or omit low-relevance desks before cutting that substance.
Do not let older remembered preferences reinstate the superseded mandatory operations lead or ban daily market reporting.

desks.label: Technology
topics: AI model releases, inference economics, GPU and compute supply; Dynamo, Model Express, vLLM, SGLang, Triton, NIXL, CUDA and NVIDIA NeMo Agent Toolkit
Competitive inference serving, including Nebius, Inferize, and Token Factory; verify the current integration and production state
Kubernetes, GPU scheduling, infrastructure tooling and substantive open-source systems work
rules: Name the capability, workload, constraint, version and comparison conditions; explain what the system does and what it costs.
Attribute vendor speedups and separate controlled benchmarks from production evidence. A claimed 70x or 10–30% gain is not an independently established result. Never call a product revolutionary.

desks.label: Business
topics: NVDA closes, earnings, buyback authorizations versus actual repurchases, demand and production evidence, compared with semiconductor and broad-market benchmarks
AMD, Qualcomm licensing with Apple and Snapdragon launches, TSMC, Intel, Samsung, SK Hynix, CXMT and YMTC; HBM4 plans versus shipped supply
Cloud capex, data-center financing, debt-funded AI buildout concentration and customer or counterparty exposure; material DPZ, IBM and CRWV developments
rules: Check all three beats: NVDA, the semiconductor complex, and AI-infrastructure economics. A quiet beat need not produce filler.
Date every quote, financial period and estimate; state currency, exchange/session, close versus intraday, and same-session benchmark changes. Preserve source precision.

Name sources. Separate analyst speculation, announced capacity, signed financing, capex commitments and observed production or revenue. Report mechanisms and exposures without inventing buy/sell advice.

desks.label: Health
topics: FDA approvals, withdrawals, safety warnings; drug shortages, pricing, pharmacy access and formulation-specific availability
Medication interactions, adverse effects and treatment-guideline changes relevant to working-age adults; personalize from current authorized private context
Evidence relevant to conditions managed by working-age adults; sleep, sedentary tech work, long working hours and travel
rules: Health is a priority desk even on days with no personal medical news. Never infer a diagnosis or current regimen from a general interest.

For quantitative study claims give effect size, absolute and relative risk when reported or calculable, denominator, time horizon, study design, population, uncertainty and major limitations. Say when absolute risk cannot be computed; never invent it.
Distinguish observational association, randomized evidence, preprints, guidelines and regulatory notices. Do not force study statistics onto an approval or shortage notice.

Use private health context to select relevant reporting; do not print a medication roster or give dosing changes. Check original research, current labels and official notices before making interaction or safety claims.

desks.label: Sports
topics: Fantasy football: Jenkins in Fowling Friends and Triskelion Gamesters in Driveway Tailgaters; refresh league identity, scoring, standings, rosters, byes, waiver rules and deadlines from connected ESPN evidence
Practice DNP/Limited/Full by day, official game status, snap counts, routes, targets and target share, touches, coaching/usage changes and waiver-relevant breakouts
Steelers, Yankees, Michigan State football and men’s basketball by season; verified game-day listening links when useful
rules: Load espn-fantasy-football for in-season fantasy reporting. Treat each league independently, including odd-team byes, waiver priority and lineup holes. Never suggest a player already rostered as a waiver pickup.

Give the specific usage, eligibility and timing that change a lineup decision, with source dates and scoring period. A practice absence is not a game designation; an IR slot is not proof of current injury status.
Refresh records, injuries, availability and alternatives every edition. The supplied October 2026 Week 4 examples are transient context, not recurring facts.
Separate live estimates from final scores; replace superseded numbers and record a dated correction. No roster or waiver transactions.

desks.label: World
topics: Taiwan Strait and China tensions affecting TSMC or semiconductor supply
U.S. and allied chip/AI-hardware export controls and their international supply consequences
Memory-supply geopolitics in South Korea and China; country-level energy and power policy constraining data-center buildout
rules: Frame the change in compute supply, cost or portfolio exposure. Attribute government and vendor projections; distinguish enacted measures, factory output and shipments from promises.

desks.label: U.S.
topics: Export-control enforcement, AI/chip antitrust, tax and energy policy affecting data centers, and engineer labor markets
rules: State the legal or economic mechanism, jurisdiction, effective date, affected parties and implementation status. Explain cost, competition or portfolio consequences.
Skip campaign coverage unless an outcome has a direct industry or market consequence.

desks.label: Science
topics: Materials and lithography, including High-NA EUV adoption by TSMC, Samsung and Intel
Quantum computing with workload-specific comparisons to classical computation
Energy, cooling and the physics of compute
rules: Keep the mechanism in the story. Separate laboratory demonstration, adoption plans and production deployment.
For quantum advantage identify the task, classical baseline, error correction and practical limits; a narrow benchmark does not prove general superiority.

desks.label: Opinion
topics: Evidence-led arguments on AI economics, semiconductor geopolitics and market structure by writers with demonstrated domain depth
rules: Label every piece Opinion, name the author and show the evidence-to-conclusion chain and strongest material counterevidence. Keep it visually distinct from reported news; it cannot be the reported-news lead.
No promotional or ideological filler. Commentary is not confirmation of its factual premises.

desks.label: Arts
topics: AI in film, music and publishing; creator economics, training-data licensing/copyright, and creative-industry labor
rules: Explain technical reality and human consequence. Mainstream exhibition and season-preview coverage merits only a brief when useful.

desks.label: Style
topics: Remote/hybrid work economics, engineering compensation and relocation, tech culture, and practical logistics for a Michigan engineer who travels for work
rules: Choose coverage that helps the reader run his working life. Minimize fashion and celebrity coverage.

desks.label: Travel
topics: Flight disruption, airline operations, concrete fares/costs, transit logistics, timing and trip weather
Colorado and Mountain West national parks and outdoor destinations
rules: Use confirmed current travel plans, not an old Boulder trip. Date prices, quote conditions and schedules; state what changes for the next trip.
Skip luxury, society and aspirational travel.

desks.label: Michigan / Region
topics: Saline, Ann Arbor and Michigan developments with meaningful local practical or national-business consequence
rules: Michigan and Ann Arbor outrank New York regional news. Omit routine regional filler or use one line.
Bank earnings, credit conditions, media-industry business and Fed-adjacent signals belong in Business or U.S., regardless of their New York dateline.

desks.label: Weather
topics: Current conditions for Saline, Michigan
The next three complete calendar days
rules: Show today plus a three-day outlook in a compact, comparable format.
Call out only consequential precipitation, wind, temperature, visibility, or severe-weather changes.

desks.label: Email & Calendar
topics: Recent Gmail threads that require action or materially change plans
Google Calendar events for today and the next three calendar days
rules: Summarize only important or actionable mail; include why it matters.
Separate today's agenda from the three-day look-ahead.
Do not expose unnecessary private message or attendee details.

desks.label: Cluster & Infrastructure
topics: Kubernetes node health, current pod failures, and rollout state across every live namespace
GPU Operator device plugin, DCGM, NFD, driver and library compatibility, and allocation failures
Flux reconciliation, drift, and relevant recent fleet-repository changes
UniFi controller, adopted devices, active clients, WAN state, pending adoptions, and material firmware notices
Synology storage health and the rsync mirror to /volume2/daedalus/datasets/cluster-maintenance/
rules: No routine survey. Check only an explicitly requested scope or a timely material incident signal; omit healthy-count recaps.
Separate present degradation from cumulative events, resolved incidents and source-only changes. Validate current impact before publishing; never reuse a remembered incident as live.
Keep any warranted detail in an optional operations continuation. Unavailable credentials are an evidence gap, not an outage.

desks.label: Outdoors & Field
topics: Seasonal bird activity, migration alerts, notable sightings, and eBird trends around Saline, Ann Arbor, and Washtenaw County
Photography fieldcraft, post-processing, and seasonal outing ideas with Alicia
Southeast Michigan weather interpreted for shooting conditions, place, and timing
rules: Favor field usefulness and seasonal specificity over generic nature copy.
Avoid gear churn; recommend equipment only when it solves a concrete field problem.
Reuse verified forecast facts from the Weather desk instead of researching a duplicate forecast.

desks.label: Culture & Leisure
topics: Vegetarian recipes, cooking technique, seasonal ingredients, and exceptional Saline or Ann Arbor restaurant ideas
Electronic, rock, and classical releases or performances with the listening time commitment stated
Science fiction and media in the orbit of Star Trek and The X-Files, including shared viewing ideas with Alicia
rules: Choose things worth the reader's downtime, not entertainment-industry churn.
Skip broad restaurant-scene coverage outside the local area.
